# Community moderation

Lucid's issues, pull requests and Discussions are covered by the
[Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Maintainers should keep technical discussion welcoming,
focused and safe for contributors.

- Redirect questions to Discussions and reproducible bugs to the issue tracker. Close duplicates
  with a link to the existing conversation.
- Ask for missing reproduction details without requesting private code, credentials or personal
  information. Remove sensitive material when possible and advise the author to rotate exposed
  credentials.
- Direct security reports to [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md); do not investigate sensitive details
  in public.
- Address conduct problems proportionately: explain the concern, hide or remove harmful content,
  and restrict participation when needed. Use GitHub's reporting and blocking tools for abuse.
- Keep private reports confidential and avoid sharing more detail than is needed to act.

For conduct reporting, use the GitHub reporting options described in the Code of Conduct. A report
sent to GitHub Support is handled by GitHub and may not reach Lucid's maintainers.
